body: It seems this doesn't properly introduce all the new `template` attributes and adds them to the various indexes (top of the `source` document has instructions). I guess some special care is needed given they seem to be parser-only.

Thanks for your work on this @mfreed7. I would say that modulo some details WebKit can be considered supportive and I don't think Mozilla is objecting (@smaug----?) so it seems okay to proceed here. I've done a mostly editorial pass. I suspect this doesn't have streaming shadow DOM just yet? I'll take a look at the DOM side as well.
I recommend we add a note at the point in the parser where we perform @rniwa's trick for some additional clarity.
@rniwa can you review the new parser bits? It seems many of the old comments are still outstanding so maybe just look at the parser aspects for now.

There's still a lot of formatting issues that make it hard to focus on the contents. I pointed out a couple, but there's quite a few more. https://github.com/whatwg/html/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#source-formatting might help in addressing these. Also happy to give pointers on Matrix as needed.

Thanks for the comments - I believe I've addressed them all.

Also, this (and the previous commit) build locally for me, but don't seem to build on github. Advice appreciated. Locally, I do get three conformance errors, unrelated to this change:

```
Success!
+ vnu output/index.html
"file:/.../html-build/output/index.html":15.39-15.60: error: Element “p” not allowed as child of element “hgroup” in this context. (Suppressing further errors from this subtree.)
"file:/.../html-build/output/index.html":59341.409-59341.412: info warning: A table row was 5 columns wide, which is less than the column count established by the first row (6).
"file:/.../html-build/output/index.html":59341.513-59341.520: info warning: A table row was 5 columns wide, which is less than the column count established by the first row (6).
```

There's still a lot of nits to go through, but I have a design question now. Would it be possible for template elements to only have a single DocumentFragment pointer? What makes it necessary for them to have two that are seemingly mutually exclusive and require additional getters and such?

(Just to mention it again, the nits I find are not necessarily exclusive to where I left the comment. I recommend reading through the PR again. Particularly in a place where you can see a diff of all the commits combined, such as here on GitHub.)
I think all comments are resolved here, except the availability of a synchronous parser endpoint that speaks DSD.
Looks good, mainly found nits and one minor thing we might want to change.

The main substantive thing is making sure `shadowrootdelegatesfocus` is properly integrated. Otherwise it's mainly a lot of editorial feedback. Some of which @domenic might want to chime in on as well.
I gave this another pass. If anyone else wants to review it now would be good as it's close.
